$comment: Source of truth for which MCP servers this registry exposes. Edit, then re-run scripts/build.sh. Entries default to source "upstream"; "local" publishes a blob from local/<name>/<version>.json instead. local/ also holds four staged Microsoft blobs not yet listed here — see README.md.

servers.name: com.atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server
servers.notes: Atlassian Rovo remote MCP server (Jira, Confluence, Loom). `latest` is 2.0.0, whose default remote is https://mcp.atlassian.com/v2/mcp. 1.1.2 stays pinned so the v1 remotes remain resolvable through the v1→v2 transition; Atlassian begins serving v2 tools to v1 connections on 2027-03-01.

servers.name: net.cerebras.sec/slack
servers.notes: Slack official remote MCP server via Runlayer proxy a4838591. Not in the upstream registry, so the blob is hand-authored. Remote points at the proxy, not mcp.slack.com, to keep Copilot under Runlayer policy and audit.
